top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §744.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a designated site director.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation. (26 TAC §744.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation posted.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §744.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Personnel files to include training were not available on site during the inspection on November 1, 2022. Training records have been requested via email and have not been provided to CCR.
